run_covost_data_prep: run the script to prepare CoVoST speech-to-text data with --data-root --vocab-type --src-lang flags
create_covost_dataset: create a CoVoST PyTorch Dataset for speech translation with source and target language pairs
extract_fbank_features: extract log mel filter bank features from audio waveforms and save as numpy arrays
generate_manifest_tsv: generate TSV manifest files with audio paths, frame counts, and target text for training splits
generate_vocab_model: generate a SentencePiece vocabulary model with bpe, unigram, or char tokenization for the task
